# <type>[optional scope]: <subject>
#
# ============================================
# Types:
# feat     - New feature
# fix      - Bug fix
# docs     - Documentation only
# style    - Code style (formatting, semicolons, etc)
# refactor - Code change that neither fixes bug nor adds feature
# perf     - Performance improvement
# test     - Adding or correcting tests
# build    - Build system or external dependencies
# ci       - CI configuration files and scripts
# chore    - Other changes not modifying src or test files
# revert   - Revert a previous commit
#
# ============================================
# Subject (required):
# - Imperative mood, no period at the end
# - First letter lowercase, under 72 chars
#
# ============================================
# Body (REQUIRED - cannot be omitted):
# Must include:
# 1. WHY this change is needed
# 2. HOW the problem is solved (key changes)
# 3. WHAT impact or side effects
#
# Format:
# - Blank line between subject and body
# - Wrap at 72 characters per line
#
# ============================================
# Footer (optional):
# Closes #123
# BREAKING CHANGE: description
# Co-Authored-By: Name <email@example.com>
#
# Note: Co-Authored-By is used when multiple people contribute
# to the same commit. Add one line per co-author.
#
# ============================================
# Examples:
#
# feat(auth): add password reset functionality
#
# Currently users cannot reset their password when they forget it,
# leading to account lockouts and increased support tickets.
#
# Implement a complete password reset flow:
# - Add forgot password endpoint that sends reset link via email
# - Create password reset form with token validation
# - Add email notification service with rate limiting
#
# Closes #234
# Co-Authored-By: Jane Doe <jane@example.com>
#
# fix(api): reduce login timeout for poor network conditions
#
# Users report frequent timeout errors on mobile networks.
# Investigation shows 5s timeout is too aggressive for 3G/4G.
#
# Increase timeout from 5s to 30s and add exponential backoff
# retry logic (max 3 attempts). Add timeout metrics for monitoring.
#
# Closes #456
# Co-Authored-By: John Smith <john@example.com>
# Co-Authored-By: Alice Wu <alice@example.com>
#
# perf(db): optimize order query with composite index
#
# Order list takes over 3 seconds when data exceeds 100k rows.
# Analysis shows existing index does not cover query pattern.
#
# Add composite index on (user_id, status, create_time).
# Query time reduces from 3.2s to 120ms on 100k rows.
